备份口令不正确或文件头已损坏，请检查后重试: The backup password is incorrect or the header is damaged. Check it and try again.
上传位置已变化，请查询已确认进度后继续: The upload position changed. Check the confirmed progress before continuing.
上传分片未完成，可从已确认位置重试: The upload chunk was incomplete. Retry from the confirmed position.

当前有任务正在执行，请等待任务结束后备份: Tasks are active. Wait for them to finish before backing up

这份备份已导入，请勿重复导入: This backup has already been imported
导入预览已过期，请重新上传或选择备份: The import preview expired. Upload or select the backup again
已有待应用的导入，请先重启服务或取消导入: An import is pending. Restart the server or cancel it first
完整恢复需要选择覆盖模式: A full restore requires replacement mode
所选范围没有可导出的数据: There is no data to export in the selected scope
另一项备份操作正在进行，请稍后重试: Another backup operation is in progress. Try again later
备份大小超出限制或文件不完整: The backup exceeds the size limit or is incomplete
所选逻辑记录过多，请缩小导出范围: Too many records selected. Narrow the export scope

子应用数据不支持复制导入，请选择跳过或覆盖: Application data cannot be duplicated. Choose skip or replace
恢复点包含凭据，请设置至少八位下载口令: Recovery points contain credentials. Set a download password of at least eight characters
备份操作失败，请检查文件、口令和版本: Backup operation failed. Check the file, password and version

导入等待超时，请检查网络连接和服务器状态后重试: The import timed out; check the network and server before retrying
已取消导入，原有数据未修改: Import cancelled; existing data was not changed
备份解包或校验失败，请检查口令、文件完整性和剩余磁盘空间: Backup extraction or validation failed; check the password, file integrity and available disk space
备份中的数据库校验未通过，原有数据未修改: The backup database failed validation; existing data was not changed
备份文件校验未通过，请重新导出或上传: Backup file verification failed; export or upload it again
